alt: 一家人背著行李、帶著棉被，疲憊地走過洪水毀損的家園，沿路尋找臨時棲身的地方。
scene_prompt: 顛沛流離 means hardship and repeated wandering without a stable home, not happy travel. Contemporary family displaced by a severe flood: father, mother and older child carrying their few possessions in worn backpacks and tied cloth bundles, trudging slowly along a dry, safe raised roadside under a gray sky. In background their damaged neighborhood sits behind receding muddy floodwater, abandoned chairs and broken roof parts visible from a safe distance. In middle distance temporary relief tents and other small families walking on the same safe path convey uncertain shelter, not vacation camping. Mother gently holds the child's hand, father carries a compact rolled blanket and scuffed suitcase; faces exhausted and worried, modest mudstained clothes, not cartoon helplessness. Exactly two arms and two legs per person, plausible baggage straps and hand grips, grounded walking feet. No one in water or danger, no weapons, injuries or corpses, no nationality cues or readable signage. Focus on forced displacement and insecure wandering.
